data.long_meaning: The name Beneia is derived from the Hebrew word ben, which means 'son' and the Hebrew word ya'anach, which means 'south'. In the Bible, the name Beneia is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ. It is believed to represent someone from the southern region of Judah. The name Beneia carries the meaning “Son of the south” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Beneia usually hope their child will grow to embody son of the south and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: בניה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בניה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשפה העברית, נגזר מהשם העברי בניהו, שפירושו בן אליהו, בת של אליהו הנביא בירושלים. השם בניהו מורכב משתי מילים: בן שפירושו בן, ו-אליהו שפירושו אלוהי ישוע. השם בניהו מוזכר במקרא כבן של אליהו הנביא, אחד הנביאים הגדולים בישראל.

in_greek.name: Βενεία
in_greek.long_meaning: Βενεία είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα, συγκεκριμένα από το όνομα Βενεία, που σημαίνει κόρη του προφήτη Ηλία. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Βενεία συνδέεται με την παράδοση της Εκκλησίας και συμβολίζει την πνευματική σχέση με τον προφήτη Ηλία, έναν από τους σημαντικότερους προφήτες στην Παλαιά Διαθήκη.

in_latin.name: Beneia
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Beneia origine Hebræum est, quod filia prophetæ Heliæ interpretatur. In traditione Christiana, nomen Beneia ad sanctorum et prophetarum traditionem pertinet, significans spiritualem conjunctionem cum propheta Heliæ, uno ex prophetis maximis in Vetere Testamento.

in_english.name: Beneia
in_english.long_meaning: Beneia is a Christian name derived from the Hebrew name Beniah, meaning daughter of the prophet Elijah. The name is rooted in biblical tradition, specifically referencing the prophet Elijah, a major figure in the Old Testament. In Christian tradition, Beneia symbolizes spiritual connection to Elijah's prophetic legacy, reflecting virtues of faith, courage, and devotion. Historically, the name Beneia has been used across various Christian cultures, signifying a strong biblical heritage.

historical_references.reference: The name Beneia is believed to have originated from the Hebrew words 'ben' meaning son and 'yah' meaning God, translating to 'Son of God'. This name was given to a group of Jewish Christians in the 1st century AD who were followers of a preacher named Benaias, also known as Benayah or Barnabas.

Another theory suggests that the name Beneia may have been derived from the town of Benevento in Italy. During the Middle Ages, Benevento was an important center of Christian pilgrimage, and the name Beneia may have been used to refer to the people or territory associated with this town.
